title: How to Build a Quiz App with AI (No Code, No Developer)
summary: How to build a quiz app with AI — no code, no developer needed. Skip Typeform's $83/month. Build your own with database, auth, and hosting all included.
body_markdown: Form tools are built for fast setup on common survey patterns. The moment you need custom scoring logic, retake limits, SSO login, leaderboards, or integrations beyond their native connectors, you hit a wall — or an Enterprise upsell. A custom-built quiz app has no ceiling on what it can do, carries no per-response or per-seat pricing, and runs on your own domain with your branding.
